scope: Complete installation and commissioning of one explicitly scoped building-management system with 2 selected DDC controllers DDC-24IO, 120 physical points, one operator workstation WS-BMS-01 and BACnet/IP integration. HVAC equipment, electrical distribution, fire-alarm logic, access-control equipment and field sensors or actuators not explicitly included by the project schedule are excluded.
sourceAuthority: Approved BMS design organization, controls integrator, equipment manufacturer, commissioning authority and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved BMS architecture and network topology
approved controller, panel, I/O-module and workstation schedule
approved point list with physical and integration points distinguished
power, control and network cable schedule with containment routes
termination, labeling, fastening, consumable and protective-bonding schedule
installation method with labor and tool quantities
software configuration, graphics and commissioning method
point-to-point test report and as-built register schedule
controller supplier package size and approved retained spare quantity
forbiddenClaims: BMS quantities derived from floor area alone
static 432-m route or generic electrical productivity
automatic controller, I/O, field-device or integration-gateway selection
universal spare quantity or supplier package
HVAC plant, electrical distribution, fire-alarm or access-control system included
